data.message: Hey Charlie! I've got my O2 filter task to do here.

I found Diana's body in electrical. Here's exactly what happened: I was coming from oxygen through upper engine and medbay. While I was near medbay, I saw Eve head into electrical. A little bit later, I saw Eve come back out of electrical and head towards upper engine. Right after she left, I walked into electrical and found Diana dead. 

Eve, you have a lot of explaining to do. Charlie, you were in medbay around that time too, did you see Eve moving in and out of electrical? I'm highly suspecting Eve right now.

I started my round in electrical, then moved through medbay and upper engine before ending up in oxygen. 

Bob, your story is a bit strange to me. You claimed you came from oxygen through upper engine and medbay towards electrical. Given my route was the exact opposite (electrical -> medbay -> upper engine -> oxygen), we absolutely should have crossed paths somewhere along the way, but I didn't see you at all this entire round. 

I can confirm that I saw both Eve and Charlie in medbay early on (around tick 2). At the very end of the round, right before the meeting, Charlie entered oxygen coming from the cafeteria. 

I'm keeping my eyes on Bob right now because his story doesn't line up with what I experienced. I want to hear from Eve and Charlie to see if they can clarify what happened around medbay and electrical.

I was completely isolated this round down on the bottom right. I started in Navigation and just moved into Storage, and I didn't cross paths with a single person. So unfortunately, I can't provide any direct sightings for the crime scene in Electrical.

However, based on what's been said, Frank makes a massive point. If Bob was traveling South from Oxygen down to Electrical, and Frank was traveling North from Electrical up to Oxygen, they absolutely should have bumped into each other in Upper Engine or Medbay. The fact that Frank didn't see Bob at all is extremely suspicious. Since there's only one Duck in our game, this heavily implies Bob might be lying about his route to set up a frame-job on Eve.

Eve and Charlie, you two are the key to figuring this out since you're the last to speak. We need you to clarify exactly where you were. Did you see Bob or Frank in Medbay or Upper Engine? Eve, did you actually go into Electrical like Bob claims? 

I'm leaning toward suspecting Bob right now because his story is structurally falling apart, but I'm going to wait and hear what Eve and Charlie have to say before I lock in my vote.

I can clear up a lot of the confusion here, because my observations perfectly connect the dots. 

First, my route was Cafeteria -> Medbay -> Cafeteria, and then I headed into Oxygen right at the end (which is where you saw me, Frank). 

Frank, I can completely confirm your story: you, me, and Eve were all in Medbay around tick 2. However, I think you and Bob just barely missed each other in the hallways. I stayed in Medbay a bit longer, and at tick 4, I actually saw Bob enter Medbay coming from Upper Engine. This means Bob is telling the truth about his route.

More importantly, also at tick 4, I saw Eve leave Medbay and head directly toward Electrical. This exactly matches what Bob claimed he saw. I went back up to the Cafeteria after that so I didn't see the aftermath, but my sightings 100% corroborate Bob's timeline and his story. Bob isn't lying to frame anyone; he really was there, and Eve really did go into Electrical where Diana was found.

Eve, you are the last to speak. You went into Electrical right before Diana was found dead, and both Bob and I saw you. You have a lot of explaining to do, but right now, all the evidence points directly to you being the Duck. I'm waiting to hear your defense, but I am very likely voting for Eve.

Okay, everyone, take a breath, because Charlie just handed me the key piece of evidence that actually clears me — let me walk through this carefully.

Yes, I went into Electrical. I'm not denying it. My route was medbay -> electrical -> medbay. I was in medbay with Charlie and Frank around tick 2, hung around doing a task, then at tick 4 I headed to electrical. Here's the critical part: **when I was in electrical, Diana was ALIVE.** I saw her there at tick 5, working on something. I didn't have any reason to stay so I turned around and walked back to medbay, where I saw Bob at tick 7.

Now think about the timeline Bob laid out: he says he saw me go INTO electrical, then saw me come OUT of electrical, and THEN he walked in and found Diana dead. That means Bob entered electrical immediately after I left. Diana was alive when I left. So between me leaving and Bob "discovering" the body, the only person in that room with Diana was **Bob himself.**

And Frank — your point still stands and it's huge. Your route was the literal reverse of Bob's. You went electrical -> medbay -> upper engine -> oxygen. Even if Charlie saw Bob enter medbay at tick 4, you and Bob still should have crossed in upper engine. You didn't see him. That's a real hole.

Charlie, I appreciate you confirming I went toward electrical — that's accurate. But "Eve walked toward electrical" doesn't equal "Eve killed Diana." It just means I was the perfect patsy for Bob to frame, because he watched me go in and waited for me to leave.

Bob reported the body. Bob's route has a contradiction with Frank's. Bob conveniently "found" Diana the moment after I left. That's the classic impostor playbook — kill right after the scapegoat leaves, then report fast to lock in the narrative.

My vote is going to Bob. I urge everyone to think about who actually had opportunity and motive to frame, not just who walked through a room.

I've already spoken — but since the floor is back to me to close, let me say this one more time clearly: Bob entered electrical right after I left, and Diana was alive when I walked out. Charlie, you confirmed I was in medbay with you and Frank, and you confirmed Bob entered medbay at tick 4 — which is exactly when I left toward electrical. That puts Bob behind me on the same path, walking into a room where the only person left was Diana. Frank's contradiction with Bob's route is still unresolved. You're all locking in on the easy answer because Bob shouted first. If you vote me out and Diana's killer is still on this ship, remember I told you to look at Bob. My vote stays on Bob.
